name: mirage
text:
It is a dollar limit, not a count of bets. Open the Kalshi tab, go to the Auto page ("Auto-bet on Kalshi"), and tap a chip under "Most per day": $25, $50, $100, $250 or $500. The default is $50. The same page has "Most per bet" and "Most on one game". Those limits only apply to the Kalshi side. The Novig limits are separate, in Settings > Betting & Novig account.

The Kalshi auto-bet runs only while the phone app is open. The GitHub engine has no Kalshi lane yet.
